meta.title: MCP task bridge
meta.description: Run allowlisted legacy MCP Tasks as DSH background jobs. Completion resumes the owning session without model polling; use mcp_task_tools, mcp_task_start and standard job controls. Includes the current SSH server. Separate connections; tracking is process-local. Uses stock job notices with an idle-owner wake fallback. Supports 2025-11-25 Tasks, not the newer extension; no interactive input or rich image delivery.
